summary: The claimed lower bound and divergence are proved without mathematical errors or gaps. The accepted exact depth formula applies to the unchanged complete support and original normalized log-affine weights. The canonical parity array factors over blocks, its zero-root probability and conditional source entropy are computed correctly, and the affine barycenter identity gives the stated global gap formula. The entropy deficit estimate, finite Fourier concentration bound, inclusion of the zero-block boundary case, and Chebyshev estimate establish the displayed bound for every integer k >= 32.
